note: One entry per sign. glove = the model recognizes it (labels.txt); avatar = the avatar engine can perform it; verified = its form was checked against an ASL reference (Sign Vocabulary v2.1). en/ar.word = display text; spoken = text-to-speech; variants = what speech-to-text may hear for this sign (matched exactly after normalization, never fuzzy). draft = text not yet approved by the user.

signs.label: one
signs.description: Index straight, other fingers closed, thumb over them; index up, palm toward you, still.

signs.label: two
signs.description: Index and middle straight (V), thumb holds ring and pinky; fingers up, palm toward you, still.

signs.label: three
signs.description: Thumb, index and middle straight (ASL form); fingers up, palm toward you, still.

signs.label: four
signs.description: Four fingers straight, thumb folded on the palm; fingers up, palm toward you, still.

signs.label: five
signs.description: Whole hand open, fingers spread; fingers up, still.

signs.label: me
signs.description: Index straight; points to your own chest and touches it.

signs.label: you
signs.description: Index straight; points forward at the other person.

signs.label: hello
signs.description: Flat hand (B), fingers together, thumb folded; salute: fingertips at the side of the forehead, the hand moves out and away.

signs.label: thanks
signs.description: Flat hand (B); fingertips at the chin, the hand moves forward and down, ends palm up.

signs.label: please
signs.description: Flat B hand; palm flat on the chest, circles.

signs.label: yes
signs.description: Fist (S); the wrist nods up and down, like a head nodding.

signs.label: no
signs.description: Index and middle straight together, snap shut onto the thumb; in front of the shoulder, twice.

signs.label: sorry
signs.description: A fist (thumb straight up along the side); on the chest, circles.

signs.label: water
signs.description: Index, middle and ring straight (W), thumb holds the pinky; the index fingertip taps the chin twice.

signs.label: bye
signs.description: Open hand, fingers bend down and up together, twice or more; palm out, at shoulder height, the arm stays still.

signs.label: come
signs.description: Index curls in and straightens (one-handed form); palm up, beckons toward you.

signs.label: drink
signs.description: C shape, as if holding a cup; at the mouth, tilts toward you.

signs.label: call
signs.description: Thumb and pinky straight (Y); beside the ear and cheek.

signs.label: iloveyou
signs.description: Thumb, index and pinky straight (ILY); palm out, held still in front.

signs.label: hungry
signs.description: C shape; on the upper chest, moves down once.

signs.label: coffee
signs.description: Two S fists stacked, the top one grinds in a small circle (two-handed; not in Sign Vocabulary v2).

signs.label: doctor
signs.description: Bent fingertips tap the inside of the other wrist, twice (two-handed; not in Sign Vocabulary v2).

signs.label: home
signs.description: Fingertips together (flat O); mouth, then cheek (Sign Vocabulary v2 backup sign).

signs.label: family
signs.description: Two F hands, palms out, circle outward and meet with the palms in (two-handed; not in Sign Vocabulary v2).

signs.label: help
signs.description: A hand (thumb up) on the flat other palm, both lift (two-handed; not in Sign Vocabulary v2).
